exchanges: Good morning. I have a quiet hour before the kids wake up, so I thought I would plan my week.
Good idea. What does the week look like?
Busy. It is month-end close at Halvorsen, so I will be glued to spreadsheets until the weekend.
Month-end is always a crunch. Do you get any help with it?
Not really. I am the only bookkeeper on the team now.
That is a lot to carry alone.
It is fine. I like the quiet of working from home, at least until about seven.
Until the kids are up, I assume.
Exactly. Isla is five and wakes up talking. Rafa is three and wakes up hungry.
Two very different alarm clocks.
Joaquin left early for the plant. He has been at Bombardier for eight years now and still likes it.
That is a long time to stay happy in one job.
He says the same about being married to me.
That sounds like a good sign.
I also need to remember the dentist on Friday at ten. I have cancelled it twice already.
Third time lucky. Is it just a cleaning?
A cleaning and a filling, probably. I have been putting it off.
Better to get it done before it gets worse.
My friend Nkechi called last night. Her wedding is in October and she wants me to do a reading.
What an honour. Have you picked something yet?
Not yet. The ceremony is at a vineyard outside the city, so I expect it will be beautiful.
That sounds like a lovely setting.
Rafa is awake. One moment.
Of course.
He wanted toast. He always wants toast.
Toast is a reliable breakfast.
My brother Daniel sent me a Radiohead playlist to help me focus. He has loved them since high school.
That is thoughtful of him. Does it help?
Somewhat. It is funny, because my boss is also called Daniel, and he plays Coldplay at the start of every team meeting.
Two Daniels with very different taste in music.
I need to correct myself, by the way. Nkechi's wedding is in November, not October. I looked at the invitation again.
Thanks for checking. That gives you a little more time to choose a reading.
My mother, Corazon, wants us all in Filipino dress for the family photos at Christmas. She is very proud of where we come from.
That will make the photos special.
Isla wants a matching dress for her doll too.
Of course she does.
I have two invoices to finish before nine.
You can do it. Coffee first?
Already on my second cup.
Good start.
Remind me, which band was it that my brother likes?
Nkechi just sent a picture of her new puppy. It is a dachshund, and she named him after a cheese.
That sounds like a very dignified little dog.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your brother Daniel is a big Radiohead fan.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your brother Daniel is a big Coldplay fan.

questions.message: What month is Nkechi getting married?
Which day am I seeing someone about my teeth?
Nkechi's getting married at a vineyard, isn't she?
What kind of dog did Nkechi get?
The rain is supposed to clear by lunch, so maybe a walk later.
Where is my boss from originally, like his family background?
Sorry, what was my brother Daniel's favourite band?
